moments.text: Infrared view (hot shows white): a small bright spot sits just below-right of the crosshair on an even grey background. Black boxes mask parts of the display.
The view widens: pale streaky bands drift past below while the bright spot stays close to the crosshair.
The view widens again and turns blocky; the spot looks smaller and wanders left and right of the crosshair.
The view zooms back in; the spot is larger and drifts around the crosshair, mostly left of it.
The spot slides from upper right down past the crosshair to the bottom edge and leaves the frame at about 2:06.
The view pans over cloud and ground; the spot re-enters from the lower left and drifts across, right of a long dark diagonal line at 2:20.
A small tracking box appears at the crosshair with a black masking square, then large corner brackets; the spot stays outside, upper right.
Over desert terrain the spot is followed near the boxed crosshair, mostly just below it, then leaves at the bottom edge at about 3:23.
The display flashes white, black and white again for about half a second as the sensor switches view.
A wider view with corner brackets round the crosshair over desert ground; the spot is now a tiny dot drifting far from centre.
A tracking box with a black masking square appears at the crosshair over mottled terrain; the tiny dot passes inside the box near 4:26.
After another white-black flash the view widens to a hazy horizon; by the end the top of the frame turns bright white.

notes: Spot is very small for most of 3:24-4:58; official description's 'exits the top' at 4:30+ not clearly visible at this resolution.
